messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick ask for launch assets: we need reproducible bench artifacts and a tiny provenance blurb for the blog.
Ethan (Data Eng): what exact artifacts? raw outputs, latency CSV, cost calc?
Maya (Marketing): raw JSONL per variant, CSV of p50/p95/p99 (cold/warm), per-response and per-1k-token cost, and a one-line provenance (host, commit, datetime). SHA256 for files please.
Jia (Eng Runtime): OK. which prompts and which model variants?
Maya (Marketing): six prompts: signup, 1-paragraph summary, 20-token code completion, clarifying multi-turn, SQL->NL, long doc ~1.2k tokens. variants: redwood-3b.fp16, redwood-3b.q4_0, redwood-3b-small (fallback).
Noah (ProdEng): run configs: BATCH=1 and BATCH=12, warmup=3, sample_size=300 per prompt. acceptance: reproducibility token delta <=2% across repeats; if p95 variance >5% we record driver/kernel and re-run.
Ethan (Data Eng): we'll want logits dump (first 32 tokens) for the signup prompt for regression checks. Also include memory peak and GPU util traces.
Jia (Eng Runtime): will do. manifest.json will include run_cmd, env vars, seed=2026, commit, host, sha256s, and a marketing_blurb field with any caveats. we'll try to sign the manifest; if not possible mark signed=false.
ci-bot: scheduled upload job. will post presigned URLs to this thread when complete.
Ethan (Data Eng): kicking off a smoke (30 queries/prompt) now. will report quick diffs.
Jia (Eng Runtime): smoke looks fine; minor logits variations on q4_0 for code prompt but within tolerance. kicking off full runs now.
ci-bot: upload complete: https://s3.example/redwood-marketing/launch/2623456789/ (manifest.json, raw_samples/, perf/, logits_dump/)
Maya (Marketing): grabbing assets now. thanks team 389 if we hit any regression we'll revisit narrative.
